variants.name: clahe
variants.yaml:
cloud_point:
  preprocessing:
    chain:
      - method: clahe
        statistics: independent
        clip_limit: 2.0
        tile_grid_size: 8

variants.name: edge_preserving_denoise
variants.yaml:
cloud_point:
  preprocessing:
    chain:
      - method: edge_preserving_denoise
        diameter: 5
        sigma_color: 20.0
        sigma_space: 5.0

variants.name: illumination_correction
variants.yaml:
cloud_point:
  preprocessing:
    chain:
      - method: illumination_correction
        statistics: independent
        window_size: 51
        epsilon: 1.0

variants.name: local_normalize
variants.yaml:
cloud_point:
  preprocessing:
    chain:
      - method: local_normalize
        statistics: independent
        window_size: 15
        epsilon: 1.0

variants.name: pair_normalize
variants.yaml:
cloud_point:
  preprocessing:
    chain:
      - method: pair_normalize
        statistics: left_reference
        epsilon: 1.0

variants.name: specular_mask
variants.yaml:
cloud_point:
  preprocessing:
    chain:
      - method: specular_mask
        brightness_threshold: 245
        dilation_radius: 1

variants.name: denoise_clahe
variants.yaml:
cloud_point:
  preprocessing:
    chain:
      - method: edge_preserving_denoise
        diameter: 5
        sigma_color: 20.0
        sigma_space: 5.0
      - method: clahe
        statistics: independent
        clip_limit: 2.0
        tile_grid_size: 8
